newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND STABLE AGAINST DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND STABLE AGAINST DOLLAR.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was mostly stable against the dollar on Thursday in a quiet private sector market short of the U.S. currency, bankers said.

One banker said the shortage in U.S. dollars was continuing but had eased. "The shortage has eased. There is normal demand and the market is not that big, so any $10 million demand would be seen as a shortage," she said.
Bankers were unable to give any reason for the shortage.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3910 and 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3940 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average exchange rate was 3.3935 bid and 3.3957 offered, compared to 3.3935 bid and 3.3950 on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average rate at midday as 3.389033 pounds buy and 3.394890 pounds sell.
